# Question ID: literature context

Record review date, current source revision, author, reason for this pass and
prior review reused. This is a template; placeholders do not qualify a review.

## Published starting point

Primary DOI/URL; publication/version/correction status; exact Results/figure or
supplement locator; population, comparison, endpoint and biological unit; actual
access level. Explain what each paper contributes, including contrary evidence.

## Repository observation

Link current result/amendment separately from the publication. Preserve negatives,
exposure, source reuse and independence limits. State what was actually measured.

## What this question could add

Describe replication, model discrimination or the exact biological extension.
Explain why it matters beyond the closest experiment and what remains unspecified.

## Current hypothesis and rival

Full current hypothesis and strongest alternative, with comparison tuple and
source-to-observation-to-question reasoning. Do not replace them with a broad label.

## What the comparison would teach

Outcomes favoring either explanation, inconclusive outcomes, biological unit,
endpoint validity and interpretation limits. Missing laboratory facts stay open.

## Hypothesis schematic

Embed/link a versioned qualitative SVG with a caption and readout-to-decision
explanation. Register provenance only after checking it against the full dossier.
An article-local candidate may retain an explicit pending-figure note.

## Next literature check

Separate actual queries/service/date/window and inspected reference/citation
chains from planned searches. Record uninspected leads, access failures, stopping
point and the event that should reopen this comparison. No exhaustive clearance.
